title: 1986 Donruss Mike Schmidt 36 Highlights Baseball Card Philadelphia Phillies HOF
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1986 Donruss baseball card features Mike Schmidt, a Hall of Famer who played for the Philadelphia Phillies. The card showcases 36 highlights of Schmidt's career, making it a must-have for any fan or collector. The card is a standard size and is part of the base set, with no parallel or variety. It was manufactured by Donruss in 1986 and is unsigned. 

The card is perfect for fans of the Major League Baseball and sports trading cards. It belongs to the Trading Card Singles category and is a great addition to any collection. Get your hands on this unique piece of sports history today!
